name: io.github.hungovercoders/apic
title: apic
description: Run a project's .http request files as MCP tools: list, describe, run, flows, features, validate.

runtimeArguments.name: --mount
runtimeArguments.description: Mount the project, the directory holding apic.yaml or the .http files, at /work, the image's working directory.

project.description: The project directory on the host.

packageArguments.name: --env
packageArguments.description: The environment from http-client.env.json to run against (default: env in apic.yaml).
